literal: Understanding those who possess in front of speaking, of that which grows in the bed water having poured it is like.
translation: Speaking before an audience that possesses deep understanding is like pouring water into the bed of a growing plant.
modern: உணர்வாற்றல் உடையவர்களுக்கு முன்னால் ஒரு கருத்தைப் பேசுவது, வளரும் பயிரின் பாத்தியில் நீரை ஊற்றுவதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the value of addressing a receptive and intelligent audience. The phrase 'உணர்வது உடையார்' denotes those who possess the sensibility to truly grasp what is spoken. When ideas are shared with such an assembly, they are nurtured and allowed to flourish. The poet compares this to pouring water directly into the prepared bed of a growing plant, where the nourishment is fully absorbed and leads to fruitful growth.
